beats.headline: Amazonian, Shieldmaiden
beats.text: I walk into the guild alone. The women joined me after each of us already had a guide, so we come out of selection scattered to the wind. I come out a good foot taller and much wider. Amazonian. Strength first, and a good measure of dexterity. They let me pick an earth class, and there was one obvious choice. Shieldmaiden.

beats.headline: Asked about her husband
beats.text: Carl and the cat are on the panel. One of the Daughters is near them. She recognised the circus and wants to come back to the team, but we are too far. She needs levels. I ask them as a personal favour, and the cat says yes before Carl can. The One-Eyed Narwhal, tonight. Don't blow her up. Then a caller asks why I left my husband to fend for himself. He left me. He was going to get us both killed. Now he is dead and I am not. Do I regret it? Of course I do.

beats.headline: She asks them to take her
beats.text: We carried Katia and her friend through a neighbourhood boss and a borough boss, and I would do it again. Then class selection split us, and I run this party on numbers, and Katia's numbers stopped adding up next to anyone she stands beside. I cannot carry that down another set of stairs. So I am the one asking. Carl. Donut. Take her. She is better than she looks right now, and she will hate that I said so.

beats.headline: Second on the board
beats.text: Second on the draft leaderboard: Hekla, Amazonian, Shieldmaiden, level twenty-eight, a bounty of five hundred thousand, behind only Lucia Mar. Odette, who has watched her some, has her parted from her guide, and fixed on bringing Princess Donut into Brynhild's Daughters. Not for the cat's sake. The cat comes with a permanent manager, and Hekla knows about Mordecai because Katia told her.

beats.headline: Second, and another 83
beats.text: The recap puts me at two. Amazonian, Shieldmaiden, level twenty-eight, five hundred thousand gold on my head. The clip is me with the crossbow in a mass of four-legged rat things. Our train filled with monsters the same as theirs, but we had one stop to ride before the transfer station. Ours is also number 83, on the Orange and Indigo lines. No sign of the Red, the Yellow or the Nightmare lines.

beats.headline: A thousand crawlers stranded at 101
beats.text: A thousand of them are stuck at 101 on the Vermillion line, Li Jun's team among them, and there is a train sitting at 60. So I take my party into the Royal Court's safe room and I ask for help, which is not a thing I enjoy doing twice in one crawl. Katia means to use her own body as the plough. I let her offer it. That is the arithmetic.

beats.headline: Killed by the crawler she handed off
beats.text: Crawler Hekla is dead, on the train, in front of everyone. Katia aimed a Rush at Eva, went wide, and put Hekla against the wall of the cab instead. The first crawler this season to kill one of the top ten and claim the bounty. A golden Player Killer Skull, and five hundred thousand gold on Katia's head.
